name: Recital AB
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – 2024 annual report
part_text: AB. whereas on 28 May 2024, Norway, Ireland and Spain recognised the State of Palestine, followed on 4 June 2024 by a decision of Slovenia’s parliament to do the same; whereas a majority of 15 Member States, including Germany, France, Italy, the Netherlands, Portugal, Austria, Finland and Denmark, have still not officially recognised Palestine as a state;
